metadata.name: I.S.A.A.C
metadata.description:
The Intuitive System for Assisting in the Annihilation of Creatures!
This mod adds a new active item to the treasure room pool that freezes enemies in their place, allowing you to select one to fire a volley of 5 of your tears.
IF YOU'RE GETTING A BLACK SCREEN WHEN PLAYING THE GAME, TRY USING THE NON-SHADER VERSION, THIS IS HIGHLY LIKELY FOR STEAM DECK USERS!
Non-shader version here: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2967464223
